title: 第三章 杀天子第十五章 百姓苦求月票求推荐票
lines: 经常用刀杀人的朋友应该知道，刀在杀人的时候与其说是劈砍，不如说更多的是拉，拉动锯子那样的拉。
即便是百锻钢刀。
如果不是熟能生巧，技巧已经到了有间入无间的程度。
单纯的劈砍面对坚韧的人体，刀是很容易嵌在人骨上的。
所以顺势一拉，就是最好的选择。
不仅能制造更大的劈砍伤口，还可以有效的控制住保命杀敌的兵刃，所谓战场刀法最后也只有缠头裹脑四字精要。
陈麻子是禁军勇卫营的百夫长。
是用刀的好手。
他的刀曾经劈砍过抗税的泥腿子，硬骨头土财主，大户人家娇生惯养的肉票，还有大曜朝武备松弛的卫所军户，冒充土匪的精锐军士，以及高高在上的进士老爷，当然了，这很偶尔也非常隐蔽。
但不管是什么样的人。
刀劈进去都差不多，最多就是韧一点或者软一点。
可是……
当陈麻子的钢刀利索的剁入废，哦不，是剁入当今天子的脖子时，肌肉记忆驱使之下他下意识一拉，手上的钢刀却是纹丝不动！
不仅是一柄，而是整整五柄。
象征着羽林卫身份的百锻宝刀或斩或捅，成功的没入了左墟的身躯。
鲜血飙射！碎布横飞！
按理说人被杀就会死，左墟应该当即软软趴下猜对，然而这致命伤落在他的身上，他却是了然的歪了歪脑袋道。
“是朕没想到这一层啊。”
一句没头没脑的话，无法抽刀回去的禁军们肯定是无法理解。
但是很快他们就理解了这句话是什么意思。
那可是天子啊！
莫说天下万民了，就是他自己的千金之躯，也要听从天子的命令！将其命令、驱使、控制此为常态！！
血一瞬间就止住了。
钢刀也离开了肉体，不是被这群杀人如麻的丘八抽回去的。
而是被左墟开始蠕动的肌肉给硬生生弹出去！活生生挤断！直挺挺崩飞！
他们胯下原本乖巧受控的战马开始不安踱步。
看似瘦弱的昭明帝左墟对此并不满意，角力的另外一方，力气太小了。
“砍人都没力气，还敢说自己是禁军？”左墟微微皱眉，他的右手对准陈麻子方向简单一拳打了出去。
没有任何预兆。
陈麻子下意识闭上了眼睛，他能感受到很多温热的碎块打到了脸上，胯下战马摇晃便是将他给带着斜栽向地面。
一拳，爆掉了一头战马的脑袋。
这他妈是拳头？！
差点吓尿裤子的勇卫营军士心中惊恐万状，这不是拳头，那分明是炮弹！哪有人的拳头可以把战马的脑袋整个轰碎掉的？
一匹战马能满足嗜血皇帝么？
显然不能，绝对不能，肯定不能！
不管是出于什么样的目的，什么样的心态，左墟动手了。
他的速度并不算多快，至少是人眼可以看清，他简单的一个纵身，两只手分别拽住了一个禁军，这两个倒霉的家伙连人带甲加起来至少两百多公斤的重量，被左墟以强手裂颅的残暴姿势拽下来！砸在一起！
content_en:
Friends who often use knives to kill people should know that when killing people, the knife is more about pulling than chopping, like pulling on a saw.
Even a hundred-forged steel knife.
If it's not that practice makes perfect, the skill has reached the point where it can only be achieved from time to time.
When faced with the tough human body when simply chopping, the knife can easily become embedded in the human bones.
So taking advantage of the trend is the best choice.
Not only can it create larger chopping wounds, it can also effectively control the weapon to save your life and kill the enemy. In the end, the so-called battlefield swordsmanship only has the essence of wrapping the head and brain.
Chen Mazi is the centurion of the Yongwei Camp of the Forbidden Army.
He is a good hand with a knife.
His knife has cut through the mud-legged people who resisted taxes, the hard-nosed local rich people, the pampered butchers of wealthy families, the lax military households of the guards in the Great Yao Dynasty, the elite sergeants pretending to be bandits, and the high-ranking Jinshi masters. Of course, this happened very occasionally and very covertly.
But no matter what kind of person he is.
It's pretty much the same when the knife cuts into it, at most it's a little tougher or a little softer.
But...
When Chen Mazi's steel knife was sharply chopped into pieces, oh no, it was chopped into today's neck, he pulled subconsciously driven by muscle memory, but the steel knife in his hand did not move at all!
Not just one, but a whole five.
The hundred-forged sword that symbolized Yulin Wei's identity was either chopped or stabbed, and was successfully engulfed in Zuo Xu's body.
Blood spurts! Rags flying!
It stands to reason that people will die if they are killed. Zuo Xu should have immediately laid down and guessed correctly. However, when this fatal injury fell on him, he tilted his head and said clearly.
"I didn't expect this level."
The Imperial Guards who couldn't draw their swords and go back would definitely not be able to understand such a meaningless statement.
But soon they understood what it meant.
That is the emperor!
Not to mention all the people in the world, even his own body of gold must obey the emperor's orders! Make it the norm to order, drive, and control it! !
The bleeding stopped instantly.
The steel knife also left the body, and was not pulled back by this group of murderous Qiu Ba.
Instead, he was forcefully ejected by Zuo Xu's squirming muscles! Squeeze it alive! Straight up and down!
The originally well-behaved and controlled horses under their crotches began to pace uneasily.
The seemingly thin Emperor Zhaoming Zuoxu was not satisfied with this. The other side of the struggle was too weak.
"You don't even have the strength to cut people, how dare you say that you are a member of the imperial army?" Zuo Xu frowned slightly, and pointed his right hand in the direction of Chen Mazi and punched him simply.
There was no warning.
Chen Mazi closed his eyes subconsciously. He could feel many warm pieces hitting his face. The horse under his crotch shook and pushed him diagonally to the ground.
With one punch, a war horse's head was blown off.
Is this a fucking fist? !
The sergeant of the Yongwei Battalion who almost peed his pants was so frightened that this was not a fist, it was clearly a cannonball! Who can blow a war horse's head to pieces with his fist?
Can a war horse satisfy a bloodthirsty emperor?
Obviously not, absolutely not, definitely not!
No matter what the purpose or mentality, Zuo Xu took action.
His speed was not very fast, at least it could be seen clearly by the human eye. He simply jumped up and grabbed a forbidden soldier with both hands. These two unlucky guys weighed at least two hundred kilograms together with their armors. Zuo Xu dragged him down with a brutal gesture of splitting the skull with his strong hands! Smash them together!
